_about: The Settings page, as data: add a row here to add a setting.
category: one of the categories below. icon: a name from ICONS in settings.js.
setting-text  edits one of the home screen's own settings (key), saved at once
config        a homelab.env value (key), applied with an action from
scripts/agent/actions.json that accepts that key as a param
action        a button that runs an action from actions.json, after confirm
info          a read-only value: config.<KEY>, device.<field>, or a named
admin         the admin mode switch (asks for the password to turn on)
open          a button opening one of adlerOS's windows (target: terminal)
admin: true on a row: it only works while admin mode is on.
mode: "homelab" or "standalone" on a row: only shown in that kind of install.
keywords: extra words the search box matches.

rows.title: Name
rows.description: Used in your greeting.

rows.title: Password
rows.description: The password for this home screen.

rows.title: Wallpaper
rows.description: Add your own by putting images in containers/core/os/wallpaper.

rows.title: Desktop mode
rows.description: Windows side by side that you move and resize, your apps in windows of their own, and your Desktop folder on the desktop. Just for this device: the TV can keep the home screen.
rows.keywords: windows window manager floating desktop computer laptop multitask side by side split

rows.title: Welcome tour
rows.description: The first-login welcome again: where your apps are (and, on its own, where your compose folders are), and a look around.
rows.keywords: welcome tour intro introduction help guide first start compose folders find apps

rows.title: Web search
rows.description: Where the search bar on your home screen takes you. {QUERY} becomes what you typed.
rows.keywords: search engine 4get google duckduckgo searxng url

rows.title: Domain
rows.description: Every app lives at <app>.<domain>.

rows.title: Timezone
rows.description: Used by every app for times and schedules.

rows.title: HTTPS
rows.description: How your apps are encrypted in the browser. See docs/tls.md.

rows.title: Tailscale address
rows.description: Reach any app directly at this address and its port.

rows.title: Storage folder
rows.description: Where photos, music, documents and notes live.

rows.title: Address
rows.description: How apps found or installed here are reached: http://<this>:<port>. Set ADLEROS_HOST in adlerOS's .env.

rows.title: Compose folders
rows.description: Where adlerOS looks for your apps (COMPOSE_ROOTS in its .env).

rows.title: Look for new apps
rows.description: Goes through your compose folders again: new compose files become apps, sorted into collections.
rows.keywords: scan rescan discover find compose import

rows.title: Admin mode
rows.description: Lets you restart and shut down this machine, delete apps, and stop core apps (Pi-hole, Vaultwarden). Off until you turn it on.
rows.keywords: administrator sudo power delete danger advanced

rows.title: Back up now
rows.description: Copies every app's settings and data into backup/. Apps pause while it runs.

confirm.title: Back up now?
confirm.body: Each running app stops while its data is copied, then starts again. Usually a few minutes.

rows.title: Update homelab
rows.description: Gets the latest version of this repository, re-runs install.sh, and restarts adlerOS.

confirm.title: Update your homelab?
confirm.body: Pulls the latest version and re-applies it. Apps whose settings changed restart.

rows.title: Update adlerOS
rows.description: Gets the newest adlerOS (git pull) and restarts it.

confirm.title: Update adlerOS?
confirm.body: It downloads the newest version and restarts; the page reloads when it's back.

rows.title: Terminal
rows.description: A shell on this machine, in a window. Off unless ADLEROS_TERMINAL=on on the machine; asks for your password each time.
rows.keywords: shell console ssh bash command line

rows.title: Device
rows.description: This machine.
rows.keywords: hardware model os kernel raspberry pi

rows.title: Restart
rows.description: Restarts the machine. Every app comes back on its own.

confirm.title: Restart now?
confirm.body: Every app is unavailable for a minute or two while the machine restarts.

rows.title: Shut down
rows.description: Turns the machine off. Starting it again needs someone at the machine.

confirm.title: Shut down?
confirm.body: Every app goes offline until the machine is switched back on by hand.
